title: Ruthie Ann Miles who played Light, she gave everything! #Lightinthepi...
transcript: I just got back from seeing Light in the Piazza at New York City Center and I have to say I think this might be my favorite production City Center has ever done? Now I've been a fan of the score for a while I think it is one of the most beautiful musical theater scores ever written no qualifier but I've never actually gotten to see the show live because it's very rarely done and so I was so excited when Encores announced this is part of their season and that I finally got to see like a full production of it. Now I will say, having only listened to the cast recording, I was kind of surprised to find out what the show is actually about. Because listening to the cast recording I thought it was just like a cute little love story set in Italy and that's kind of what it is but also there's like a whole other layer that I did not think came through on the cast recording and I was completely caught off guard by. I think it's that additional layer that makes the show so divisive like even coming out of the theater I heard some audience members being like “Oh this is the best show I've ever seen” and I've heard other being like “I hated that like I thought that was so terrible” and I totally get why this show would not work for everyone, but it totally worked for me! I thought it was absolutely gorgeous! I thought the cast was stunning; Ruthie Ann Miles I think is one of the most talented actresses we have working today and I'm always excited to see her on stage. Anna Zavelson who plays Clara I know everyone's been giving her praise but like holy shit she was so good! Like I thought she was the standout of the show And this is like her debut and I cannot wait to see what she does after this because she is a star! I know with City Center there's always like this like Will it transfer? Won't it transfer? And recently like a lot of them have been transferring but some of them haven't. I really hope we get some kind of second life with this production. I would love to see a proper Broadway revival where they have time to really refine it similar to the way Parade did. Because I think this could be a really really special revival if it was able to go to Broadway. At the very least I hope we get a cast recording so I can just listen to it over and over and over again because I really thought that this production was fantastic. And it closes tomorrow, so you may not get a chance to see it, but hopefully we get a chance to see it again in the future!
